summary: Spec-only design note written to design-notes.md (anatomy, visibility tiers, relationship-state/action matrix, own-bio inline editing, loading/error/404/preserve-cache states, a11y/reduced-motion, per-platform notes incl. desktopScope allowlist). Uses existing Theme.swift / theme.js / forms.css conventions; no new tokens. Note: no design-kit/ directory exists in the repo; docs/design/overview.md and the Theme files were used. Five creative decisions below each have 2-3 alternatives with a recommendation and need Jacey's approval before iOS/web implementation steps; the design note assumes the recommended option for each.

options.name: Tap the avatar/name everywhere; row tap unchanged
options.detail: Avatar (and name) is the profile link in: contacts rows, DM thread header, group member lists in Group Info, friend-request rows, message sender avatars in group chat; plus a 'View my profile' row in Account. Tapping the row body still opens the chat, so the common path is not slowed.
pros: Low discoverability risk because avatars already look tappable
cons: Avatar tap targets must be >=44pt, tight in dense lists

options.name: Row tap opens profile; Message is a button on it
options.detail: Contacts row opens profile first, then Message.
cons: Adds a step to the most frequent action (chatting); changes existing muscle memory

options.name: Context menu / long-press 'View profile' only
options.detail: Add item to existing row menu (web Dropdown, iOS context menu).
cons: Poor discoverability; unusable for group-chat sender avatars and request rows

options.name: iOS sheet (medium/large detents); web route /profile/:userId in FormSkin with Back control
options.detail: Matches AddFriendSheet/ReportUserSheet on iOS and the Account page pattern on web; deep-linkable (e.g. from a friend-request push). Requires a desktopScope.js route pattern and test so Tauri does not redirect it.
cons: Web leaves the Reader dock, losing scripture position/open panels on return

options.name: iOS push; web right-side drawer over the Reader
options.detail: Web drawer hosts the same Profile components with no route change (no desktopScope change).
cons: Not linkable; two host shells to test; Profile.jsx becomes a component not a page

options.name: Web in-dock panel (dockview)
options.detail: Profile as a dock panel next to messages.
cons: Touches Reader/dockview internals; heaviest, riskiest, hardest on small viewports

options.name: Primary action under identity; Block/Report/Unfriend in a labelled overflow menu
options.detail: One full-width state-driven primary button (Add friend / Request sent / Accept+Decline / Message), overflow 'More options' top right. Mirrors existing ContactRow menu.
pros: Destructive actions kept away from primary
cons: Report is one tap deeper; must stay clearly labelled for App Store 1.2 review

options.name: Vertical list of action rows below the bio
options.detail: Add friend, Message, Block, Report as full rows with icons.
cons: Heavier, less warm; visual weight on destructive items; long on small screens

options.name: Sticky bottom action bar (primary) + overflow in header
options.detail: Primary pinned to thumb zone on mobile.
cons: Collides with iOS sheet detents/keyboard and web drawers; sticky bars complicate the small-viewport case

decisions.title: What a stranger sees where the bio would be

options.name: Quiet line 'Bio is shared with friends.'
pros: Explains the gap; leaks nothing (tier rule is public policy)

options.name: Omit the bio block entirely
cons: User may think the person has no bio or the app is broken

options.name: Blurred placeholder lines
cons: Implies content exists (oracle for empty vs filled bio); poor a11y

decisions.title: Where the user edits their own bio

options.name: Inline on own profile (Edit bio in place, n/160 counter, draft preserved on error)
pros: Edit what you see; small new surface; keeps Account.jsx/AccountView+Profile.swift from growing
cons: Own profile screen needs its own entry (Account row)

options.name: Dedicated edit sheet/modal from own profile
pros: Clear focused task; reuses FSFormScaffold dirty-discard

options.name: Field in Account page profile form
cons: Grows two already-oversized files, against the 2026-09-05 restructure principles

implementation_flags: Unfriend undo is a client-side 6s deferred commit (server cannot restore a friendship); Block 'Unblock' toast does not retract the auto-filed report and must be labelled Unblock, not Undo.
Add-friend/accept errors use uniform copy per security D5; no 'not found' or 'blocked' wording anywhere.
If B1 is chosen, lib/desktopScope.js needs a UUID-tail route pattern + test or Tauri redirects to /reader.
Profile payload must include username (existing request/accept endpoints are username-keyed) and relationship enum none|request_sent|request_received|friends|self.
Cache must be dropped on 404, local block/unfriend, and sign-out (security D10), while kept on other failed refreshes.
textMuted (@0.28) fails AA; use textSecondary or stronger for all meaningful text.
